parts.text: Describe the Maudsley Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory (MOCI).

parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between the Maudsley Obsessive-Compulsive
Inventory (MOCI) and the Yale-Brown Obsessive-Compulsive Scale (Y-BOCS).

parts.text:
Evaluate the treatment and management of anxiety disorders, including a discussion of the

Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Finlay et al. (2006) studied the Kranes playground design of leisure environments.
Explain what is meant by ‘playground design’ as a casino design.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the pleasure-arousal model and the cognition-emotion model of the effects of
ambience.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two weaknesses of one of these models of the effects of ambience.

parts.text: Describe the Yale model of communication as a strategy for promoting health.

parts.text:

Rosenfeld (1987).

workplace sabotage.
